title: Harvey's CEO Explains Why It's Raised so Much Money It Hasn't Touched - Business Insider
summary: Harvey, a legal AI startup, has raised nearly $1 billion in funding to accelerate its product development, including the creation of software agents for multistep legal tasks, and to compete in the crowded AI legal market.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights Harvey's successful funding rounds and strategic hires to innovate and expand its product offerings, indicating a positive market impact.
